SETTINGS
👥 MULTIPLAYER
YOUR CODE———
Send your code to a friend — anywhere in the world, any Wi-Fi or mobile data. When they type it in, they join YOUR game.
HOW TO PLAY

📱 PHONE left side = walk/drive · right side = look · 👊 punch/shoot · 🚗 enter car / use things (hold for 💰⛏) · tap the minimap = big map

⌨ PC WASD move · SHIFT sprint · SPACE jump · CLICK punch/shoot · E/F use · Q weapon · H horn · P dance · C camera · M map · N mute · B service record · Esc menu

👥 MULTIPLAYER ⚙ Settings → send your code to a friend → they tap 🔑 ENTER A FRIEND'S CODE and join your game. Up to 8 players · works anywhere over the internet (any Wi-Fi or mobile data, different countries) — the game tries up to 11 different servers at once and picks whatever gets through. 📍 GO TO = teleport to a friend.

🗺 GPS open the map, tap anywhere (or a place in ☰) → follow the purple line. Tap the pin to remove it.

🆕 MEME BAY the new district east of town: MEMEA mega store, STONKS TOWER (rooftop BASE jump 🪂), MEME MOTORS (buy a car), MEME PIZZA (delivery job), the ARENA (penalty kicks), fishing pier, MEME PIER Ferris wheel, beaches all around the island, stunt jumps and 30 hidden rubber ducks 🦆.

🌉 FORT MEME BRIDGE drive (or walk) west on the main road past WEST BEACH — the big red bridge takes you straight to the military island. Drive back the same way.
